name: trawl_net
description: Crude empty trawl net (057): a long see-through cone of black cross-hatched mesh, rope-frame mouth at the right with yellow headrope floats and dark footrope weights, cinched cod end tied off at the left, two tow lines leaving the mouth up and right. Anchor centre, ~660x300 (x -326..334, y -150..126). Put the catch (shark, silver_fish) on top.
